The verifier reproduces every coefficient, the spanning-tree evaluations \(\psi_H(1,1)=1296\) and \(\psi_{H^\ast}(1,1)=2000\), and the published cellular-duality identity against an independently enumerated ordinary Tutte polynomial. The domain, embedding, normalization, and finite quantifiers are explicit; no unproved infinite inference is used.

value.rationale: The two graphs are the canonical regular dual maps coming from the icosahedron and dodecahedron on \(\mathbb{RP}^2\), not an arbitrary finite slice. The exact pair gives a nontrivial benchmark for a newly introduced embedding-sensitive invariant, cross-checks its duality law on a symmetric projective example, and supplies complete data from which the corresponding generalized Krushkal information can be recovered. This is useful for implementations and for comparisons where the ordinary Tutte polynomial forgets the embedding.
